html:
Visiting Cao Bang Tiger Cave you will be immersed in the natural beauty with mysterious caves, if you are a lover of fresh air and want to explore natural beauty, then Tiger Cave is the destination for you.

Cao Bang Tiger Cave still retains its inherent wild beauty, with interesting stalactites inside. Visitors can visit and take beautiful pictures next to the Tiger Cave. Especially when coming here in the summer, you will feel the cool air.

According to the elders, the Tiger Cave means that the cave used to be the habitat of fierce tigers, however, there are also opinions that the Tiger Cave originated from the sound of the stream flowing in the cave, creating a roaring sound like a fierce tiger.

So to experience the truth of that story, let’s travel to Cao Bang with Vietlook to discover the beauty and listen to the mysterious stories about the Tiger Cave. To get here from Cao Bang city, visitors should conquer the Ma Phuc Pass, Khau Lieu Pass, then go to Nguom Ngao Cave.

Nguom Ngao Cave has stalactites with strange animal shapes, is a beautiful place to hide from the sun in Cao Bang, when the weather is right in the summer, when entering the cave, visitors will feel the natural coolness.

Entering the cave, visitors will see strange images like the pink dodder tree, the mother’s milk bottle, the magic toad, the stone guitar… a magical beauty, inside the cave there are slots leading to the sky, a natural beauty that nature has bestowed on Cao Bang.

The highlight in Nguom Ngao Cave is that there are strange shapes like the pink dodder tree, the mother’s milk bottle, the magic toad, the stone guitar, the coral tree and the ship, the golden waterfall, the silver waterfall, the upside-down lotus platform, the lonely stone pillar are enough for visitors to save for themselves beautiful pictures.

All of that beauty is natural without human intervention, here all year round there is the sound of flowing water, to go deep inside visitors have to go by boat with local people, the temperature in the cave only fluctuates between 18 and 25 degrees Celsius.

It can be said that Nguom Ngao cave is a gift that nature has bestowed upon Cao Bang, one of the caves worth visiting, to escape the sun in the summer days, to fully explore the beauty of Cao Bang, visitors only need to go on a 3-day 2-night Cao Bang tour to enjoy visiting the scenic spots, exploring the beauty of the cave or conquering the mountain pass, and enjoying delicious and attractive dishes.

What to eat when traveling to Cao Bang Tiger Cave

Roasted suckling pig

A delicious and nutritious dish, the suckling pig must weigh between 4 and 6 kg, cleaned and roasted with honey leaves, the outside of the pig is brushed with honey and spices, the pig is roasted on a charcoal stove until golden brown, crispy and fragrant with honey leaves.

Xoi tram

A specialty dish of the mountainous region, the sticky rice here is made from upland sticky rice and wild canarium fruit, when cooked the sticky rice has a very eye-catching purple color and the rich taste of canarium fruit…

Banh ap chao

One of the famous cakes in Cao Bang, the inside is made from duck meat, the cake is made from upland sticky rice so it is very sticky and fragrant, after mixing with the filling, it is fried to puff up like a fried cake, golden brown.

Cao Bang rolled rice paper

The rolled rice paper here is eaten with bone broth and minced meat with scallion oil, enjoying the hot cake in the cold weather, there is nothing more interesting.

Da Hien vegetable

This is one of the wild vegetables that grow naturally, the vegetable usually grows a lot from February to July of the lunar calendar, the vegetable is often used in parties. In particular, the vegetable is stir-fried with chicken gizzards, beef gizzards…

7-flavor roasted duck

One of the famous specialties, the cleaned duck is marinated with 7 spices and processed very elaborately, when enjoying it you will feel the unique flavor of Cao Bang.

Tram Huong fish

This is one of the most delicious dishes at Ban Gioc waterfall, after cleaning the fish will be marinated with dill, chili, onion, spices… bcj with banana leaves grilled on a charcoal stove, when enjoying it, diners will feel the sweetness.

So Cao Bang Cao Bang not only welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, winding mountain passes that always challenge drivers, or high rocky mountains undulating in the morning mist, but when coming here, visitors can also freely explore mysterious caves, the most prominent of which is Tiger Cave.
